title: Add a Python function to a written spec
prompt: Add parse_duration(text) to timeparse.py. It reads durations like "1h30m", "45s", "2h" or "1h5s" and returns the number of seconds as an int: h is hours, m is minutes, s is seconds, they come in that order, and any of them may be left out. Anything else, including an empty string, raises ValueError.
